name: Lucide Lab
about: Lucide Lab is a free, open-source icon set with 388 icons designed by Lucide Contributors. From navigation and actions to files, media and communication, it covers everyday UI needs. Every icon is available as SVG, PNG and WebP, or as a copy-paste React / TypeScript component or CDN link. Recolor and resize each one in the browser before you export – free, no account needed. Licensed under ISC.

faqs.q: Are Lucide Lab free to use?
faqs.a: Yes. All 388 Lucide Lab are open source under the ISC license – free to download, customize and use. Always check the ISC terms for attribution or commercial-use requirements.

faqs.q: How do I use Lucide Lab in React or my website?
faqs.a: Copy any icon as a React / TypeScript component straight into your project, or paste the CDN link into your HTML. Every icon also downloads as SVG, PNG or WebP, and you can recolor and resize it in the browser before you export.

faqs.q: How many Lucide Lab are there?
faqs.a: There are 388 icons in the Lucide Lab set, designed by Lucide Contributors. Use the search above to find any icon by name.

faqs.q: Can I change the color and size of Lucide Lab?
faqs.a: Yes. Open any icon, pick a size and color, and the preview updates instantly. SVG, PNG and WebP exports follow your choices, and React snippets recolor through props.

faqs.q: What formats are Lucide Lab available in?
faqs.a: SVG, PNG and WebP downloads, copy-paste React / TypeScript components, plus a CDN link for every single icon – free, no account needed.
